description: Every displayed ternary subset series is summable with sum in [0,1], and the resulting subset-to-real map is injective.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.ternaryCode_spec :
  (∀ (S : Set ℕ), Summable (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.ternaryTerm S)) ∧
    (∀ (S : Set ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.ternaryCode S ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      Function.Injective Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.ternaryCode
